key_obligations: Implement management systems for prudent business management.
Maintain and annually review written rules for risk management and internal controls.
Conduct regular internal reviews of control mechanisms at least annually.
Obtain approval of control mechanisms from the relevant authority.
Establish audit committees with at least three members, including one independent member.
summary: Insurance and reinsurance companies are required to implement robust management systems for prudent business management and maintain written rules for risk management and internal controls, which must be reviewed annually. Regular internal reviews of these control mechanisms are mandatory, and approval from the relevant authority is necessary. Companies must establish audit committees by a specified deadline, ensuring they consist of at least three members, including one independent member with relevant qualifications. Additionally, supervisory authorities have the right to mandate improvements to the management system based on risk assessments.
